name: Jade Lode
change: Varies Jade Medallion: the jade becomes a mass of jade ore filling the corner and running off-screen, with natural gold veins; the portrait sits in an ornate champagne leaf-scroll bezel; the eye button sits in a small jade outcrop right of the bars.
good: Your 'gold embedded in jade, rock running off-screen' idea worked closely: it reads as a rock face the HUD is set into; the gold bezel is ornate but in the Gildmoss champagne; the jade outcrop button is subtle and clearly a button.
watch: At a quarter of the screen width the jade mass is fairly small, so the 'mountain' effect is modest; the gold veins are faint at 1:1.

name: Rampart
change: New: the corner is a weathered castle rampart of grey-green ashlar with low merlons; the portrait sits in a stone oculus with an ornate gold bezel; the panels rest on stone corbels; the eye button sits in a single cut stone.
good: Monumental and realistic rather than a toy castle; the corbels under the panels are a convincing way to attach them to the wall; the stone-block button fits naturally.
watch: The wall runs about 47% of the way down the left edge, which is a lot of screen; the merlon silhouette is the most familiar 'castle' cliché of the set; 12 of the 13 statuses (the tent is missing).

name: Marble Frieze
change: Varies Verde Antico: the veined green marble becomes a carved temple cornice filling the corner, the laurel wreath turns to ornate champagne gold, and the eye button sits in a small marble boss.
good: The most regal and legendary; the gold laurel around the cameo is the strongest single ornament of the set; the cornice moulding gives a crisp, architectural top edge.
watch: The marble continues as a border down the left edge, about 40% of the screen height; the eye button's small gold points make it slightly fancier than asked.

name: Overgrown Relic
change: Blends Mossbound Ruin and Rootbound: an ancient granite ruin gripped by grey roots with moss and lichen fills the corner; a worn ornate gold ring frames the portrait; the eye button sits in a small root-wrapped stone.
good: Combines your two picks naturally: ancient, alive and legendary; the root-wrapped button outcrop is the most natural of the five; compact on screen.
watch: Roots and moss make a busy texture right at the corner; the gold ring is a little bright against the dark roots.

name: Nacre Shore
change: Varies River Nacre: a dark slate riverbank outcrop with seams of mother-of-pearl fills the corner; the nacre-and-pearl portrait ring gains an ornate gold setting; the eye button sits in a smooth pebble.
good: Keeps what made River Nacre special while anchoring it in the corner; pearls and gold read precious but restrained; compact on screen.
watch: The slate outcrop is small at this size, so the corner embedding is subtle; the pebble button reads more like a plain round button than a pebble.
